title: Google Earth Launches New Image Generation Feature Based on Nano Banana 2 - Instantly Generate Realistic AI Scenes and Historical Landscapes
excerpt: Amid the rapid empowerment of daily tools by artificial intelligence technology, Google Earth (Google Earth) has officially launched a new image generation feat
content_html:
Amid the rapid empowerment of daily tools by artificial intelligence technology, Google Earth (Google Earth) has officially launched a new image generation feature based on the Nano Banana2 model. By deeply integrating satellite, aerial, and 3D real-world maps with generative AI, this feature allows global web users to visually reshape real-world locations directly on the map.

As a highlight of this feature, users simply need to zoom in on a specific target area in the web version of Google Earth, click "Create Image," and input descriptive instructions to generate custom images that closely match the actual terrain based on real geographic data. This technology not only expands the boundaries of spatial visualization but also provides new solutions for multiple industry applications.

In the education sector, this feature helps history teaching move beyond the abstractness of pure text. When teachers guide students to observe world heritage sites, they can input instructions such as "render the bustling streets of Pompeii in 78 AD," and the ruins will be instantly restored into a three-dimensional scene full of Roman imperial style. At the same time, combined with Gemini's underlying retrieval capabilities, the system can also quickly generate intuitive infographics containing key historical causes around landmark buildings.

For the real estate development and urban planning industries, this technology significantly lowers the threshold for early conceptual presentations. Whether it is to show customers the future vision of transforming an empty plot in Tokyo into a commercial complex, or to simulate modern lakeside wooden houses surrounded by mountains and water for buyers, planners just need to input specific requirements, and the system can render high-precision 3D design effects on the existing natural landscape in real time, helping teams better assess the plan before construction begins.

Additionally, this tool also offers the public an entertaining experience that breaks the boundaries of reality. Users can instantly transform Google's Mountain View campus into a cyberpunk-style science fiction utopia, experiencing visual wonders of the future. Currently, this feature is officially available to web users worldwide.

content_html_zh:
在人工智能技术快速赋能日常工具的背景下，谷歌地球（Google Earth）正式推出基于Nano Banana2模型的全新图像生成功能。 通过将卫星、航空和 3D 现实世界地图与生成式 AI 深度集成，此功能允许全球网络用户直接在地图上直观地重塑现实世界位置。

该功能的一大亮点是，用户只需在网页版Google Earth中放大特定目标区域，点击“创建图像”，输入描述性指令，即可根据真实地理数据生成与实际地形高度匹配的自定义图像。 该技术不仅拓展了空间可视化的边界，还为多个行业应用提供了新的解决方案。

在教育领域，这一特点有助于历史教学超越纯文本的抽象性。 老师引导学生观察世界遗产时，输入“渲染公元78年庞贝城繁华街道”等指令，废墟就会瞬间还原成充满罗马帝国风格的三维场景。 同时，结合Gemini的底层检索能力，系统还可以快速生成包含地标建筑周围关键历史原因的直观信息图表。

对于房地产开发和城市规划行业来说，该技术大大降低了早期概念呈现的门槛。 无论是向客户展示将东京空地改造成商业综合体的未来愿景，还是为买家模拟现代湖边依山傍水的木屋，规划者只需输入具体需求，系统即可在现有自然景观上实时呈现高精度的3D设计效果，帮助团队在开工前更好地评估方案。

此外，该工具还为公众提供了打破现实界限的娱乐体验。 用户可以立即将谷歌山景城园区变成赛博朋克风格的科幻乌托邦，体验未来的视觉奇观。 目前，该功能已正式向全球网络用户开放。
